caption: The drawing consists of a single object, a large, lidded tankard or mug with a hinged lid and an ornate handle. The tankard is depicted in black line work on a plain, off-white or beige background. The tankard has a slightly tapering cylindrical body with a flat base, decorated near the bottom with a band of repeating geometric or floral motifs and additional horizontal lines. The lid is circular and flat with a raised, slightly domed central section and a knob or finial at the top, which is connected to the tankard with a hinge located at the upper end of the handle. The handle is large and curves outward and downward from the top of the body to the lower part, featuring ornamental elements along its outer edge and a thumb rest at the top. There is a small decorative element or monogram on the body of the tankard. The artist's signature, "Lawrence Flynn," is present in cursive in the lower right corner of the drawing. The line work is precise and clean, and there are no additional colors or shading in the image.
title: Silver Tankard
